verdict: Threaded STREAM is a source-supported, picture-preserving candidate for isolated measurement; not a verified fix or deployment approval.

methods: read local installed template ZIPs and cached TPZ directory
read exact4.7.2 engine source and version-labelled official docs over HTTPS
ffprobe original asset metadata without decoding PCM

baseline.observed_stream_ring: 4096 interleaved Float32 samples, stereo44100 =>2048frames/46.44ms; measured by root, not re-run here

templates.conclusion: Threaded and nothreads templates are already installed; no engine/template package download is necessary. Worklet source bytes match the currently published worklet and contain both branches. Threaded JS+WASM must be kept as their own paired/hash-labelled engine build.

confirmed: audio_driver_web.cpp:394-439 creates a dedicated Thread for AudioDriverWorklet::_audio_thread_func, calls _audio_driver_process then atomically increments shared STATE_SAMPLES_OUT, and waits on worklet notifications.
_audio_driver_process:72-94 invokes audio_server_process on that thread and writes output_rb Float32 samples; this includes STREAM mixing/decoding rather than a browser-main-thread chunk callback.
library_godot_audio.js:2129-2132 obtains heapSub views over HEAPF32/HEAP32 and passes shared state/input/output to worklet start. The threaded template creates shared:true WebAssembly.Memory.

audio.worklet.js start branch creates RingBuffer over shared typed-array views; read subtracts availability using Atomics and process_notify wakes the producer. No read/chunk round-trip through browser main JS is required for replenishment.

nothreads start_no_threads:1995-2064 instead receives read messages on browser main JS, calls out_callback synchronously and postMessage(chunk); this is precisely the supply dependency absent in the threaded route.
limits: Independent producer scheduling addresses a measured main-thread supply mechanism but does not guarantee no underruns: total CPU saturation, OS scheduling, shared audio locks, browser suspension or worklet failure can still stall it.
Graphics resolution, original shaders/assets/audio sources/sample rate can remain unchanged. Threading alone does not fix slow frame rendering, coarse main-thread fade/duck updates or input response.

Release threaded JS defaults emscriptenPoolSize to8 unless configured otherwise; shared WASM heap is not duplicated eight times, but worker stacks/JS contexts and CPU/compatibility costs must be measured.
Verify actual SharedArrayBuffer-backed buffers/threads=true at worklet start and continuously measured underruns/PCM; successful export/feature availability alone is not audio continuity evidence.

minimum_changes_only_in_new_preview: Create a dedicated child directory such as /gunman-rush/preview/mobile-web-perf-threaded/ (or separate origin). Self-host/pin the small MIT coi-serviceworker script under that directory; default worker scope must be exactly that child path.

Preview HTML/bootstrap registers the child worker before loading/starting the threaded engine, waits for its own expected scriptURL/scope to control the page, then performs at most a bounded reload so the navigation response contains COOP/COEP. Existing root cache worker controller is not proof the child COI worker is ready.

After reload require isSecureContext, crossOriginIsolated===true, SharedArrayBuffer/Atomics, AudioWorklet and WebGL2; Engine.getMissingFeatures({threads:true}) must report no missing required feature. AudioWorklet is separately required even though Godot feature checking treats audio as optional.

Load the paired threaded export JS/WASM and the same source-compatible PCK, keep1280x720 RT/original shaders/assets/audio and explicit build/engine/PCK identities. Ensure worker module and audio worklets resolve to the threaded engine location after renaming/stamping.

Do not load production cache_startup.js in the preview or register another Godot PWA worker for the same child scope. One controlling worker owns fetch interception. Root production loader/cache worker remain untouched.

Godot4.7.2 template already supplies an official COI-capable godot.service.worker.js; a preview-only PWA export with isolation headers is a supported alternative to coi-serviceworker, not a second simultaneous worker.
Present Play only after isolation is settled, then obtain a new real user gesture to unlock AudioContext; do not assume a pre-reload gesture is retained.
fallback: If service workers, secure context, isolation, SAB, workers or AudioWorklet are unavailable or initialization fails, explicitly offer/use the already identified nothreads build. A threaded WASM cannot become a nothreads binary merely by setting threads:false.
Keep separate engine filenames/metadata for each variant; reuse only source-compatible PCK bytes. Label fallback mode in diagnostic results so its timings cannot be attributed to threaded.

Bound registration/activation/reload attempts with per-preview session markers; show a recoverable fallback instead of a reload loop. Do not unregister unrelated parent/root service workers or clear production caches.
security_and_compatibility: A child worker must never use a widened root scope or Service-Worker-Allowed:/ override. Existing parent registration can initially control the child page, so validate actual controller identity.

Use same-origin engine/PCK/worklet resources and require-corp. There is no need to add third-party integrations, relax CORS or globally strip credentials. Opaque cross-origin responses cannot be transformed into permissive readable responses by this mechanism.

Stock coi-serviceworker has optional credentialless/degrade behavior and generic cross-origin CORP headers; pin/version-review it and avoid unnecessary credential changes for this same-origin-only preview.

COOP changes opener relationships; cross-origin embedding requires compatible ancestor isolation/permissions. Prefer top-level preview navigation. Existing auth/popups/third-party assets cannot be assumed compatible.

Android Chrome generally has the needed APIs, but exact Honor/Huawei Chrome version and private-mode/storage restrictions remain runtime checks. Other browsers, especially older Safari/iOS, require fallback.
Only allow existing origin-scoped assets, and keep proper WASM MIME plus current checksum/source identity checks. Do not silently loosen isolation or transport verification to force threaded startup.

sample_playback_tradeoff.interpretation: Metadata-derived stereo Float32 payload estimates, not measured RSS; actual Web mix/context rate determines frames. Five tracks sum273.67MiB@44.1k/297.88MiB@48k, plus two selected24s beds16.15/17.58MiB. The original compressed files and other game/WASM/texture memory are additional.
sample_playback_tradeoff.benefit: Browser AudioBufferSource playback avoids repeated main-thread STREAM ring replenishment once buffers are registered, without reducing original sample rate or editing sound assets.
risks: AudioDriverWeb::register_sample:215-267 synchronously decodes the complete stream into Vector<AudioFrame>, then duplicates into PackedFloat32Array. library_godot_audio.js:1649-1667 additionally creates browser AudioBuffer and temporary channel copies. Registration peak exceeds retained buffer size substantially.

GameMusic.TRACKS preloads all five stream resources. Two playback voices do not imply a two-buffer registry limit: visited SAMPLE registrations may accumulate while stream resources/JS sample registry remain alive. Explicit cache lifetime/cleanup must be proven.

Bulk conversion can create long synchronous startup/track-transition stalls and mobile memory pressure. A bounded current/next-track cache plus explicit unregister/GC observation could constrain it, but requires lifecycle work and repeated Home/plains/forest/boss tests.

Sample mode does not support all Godot AudioEffects/procedural/positional behavior. Current BGM/bed buses use volume/fade controls, but exact looping, crossfade, duck, pause, stop, gain, sample completion and bus semantics still need equivalence validation.
SAMPLE beds alone are modest memory but leave STREAM BGM starvation unresolved; it is a component experiment, not a complete fix.

latency_buffer_tradeoff.verified_minimal_entry: Exact4.7.2 main.cpp:1270 parses --audio-output-latency; current published Engine.startGame(override) updates config.args. An independent preview can pass args:["--audio-output-latency","200"] using the same existing engine/PCK before initialization, with no production-loader change or PCK rebuild.
latency_buffer_tradeoff.default: main.cpp:2847 sets Web default50ms. AudioDriverWeb:132 rounds requested frames to closest power of two. Read back actual worklet capacity/sample rate; CLI milliseconds are not the final exact latency.
latency_buffer_tradeoff.benefit: No asset/sample-rate/graphics change, tiny ring memory compared with full SAMPLE tracks, and a same-engine causal check for refill deadline pressure. Prefer bounded100/200ms trials first and report actual ring capacity.
limits: Buffering absorbs only finite main-thread pauses and requires average producer throughput to keep up. If actual gaps are several hundred milliseconds,100/200ms remains insufficient;32768frames@44.1k is743.04ms and only0.25MiB output ring but adds large reaction delay.
Larger buffering delays STREAM start/stop/fade/duck and any streamed action cue. Existing browser-native SAMPLE short SFX use a different route and must not be misattributed to this ring.
Requesting higher AudioContext latencyHint alone is not proof that Godot output ring grows. Set the official initialization latency option and inspect the actual start message/ring size.
Do not patch chunk sizes, stretch audio, drop quality/sample rate, or extend silence to hide starvation. Preserve exact underrun and PCM observations, plus response latency.
A large buffer may trade audible continuity for unacceptable latency; it is not the preferred final answer to sustained slow rendering, and can remain an explicit diagnostic/fallback option.

recommended_order: Keep the official no-GPU-query baseline and root precise-underrun/audio-off control results as their original evidence; no new timing was executed by this reviewer.
Use a separately identified same-engine buffer-latency preview as a low-change causal control; verify actual ring capacity and PCM continuity against input/gain response delay.

Prepare a child-scope isolated threaded preview retaining STREAM/assets/graphics. Measure equal-scene FPS/process/physics, exact worklet underrun, PCM, worker counts/memory and initialization/gesture/fallback behavior.

Prefer threaded STREAM if it removes deadline starvation with acceptable device resource/compatibility behavior. Keep fallback explicit. Consider bounded SAMPLE caching only if threading is unavailable or demonstrably insufficient, with memory/lifecycle evidence.
unverified: No threaded build was exported or started in this review.
No actual COI worker lifecycle, browser fallback, device compatibility, memory RSS or audio continuity was tested.
No thread candidate is signed as resolving Honor/Huawei Chrome performance, SFX audibility or player acceptance.
